definitions: The intrinsic nature or indispensable quality of something, especially something abstract, that determines its character.
A concentrated extract obtained from a plant or other substance and used for flavouring or perfume.
A philosophical term referring to the property or set of properties that make an entity what it fundamentally is, and without which it loses its identity.
examples: The essence of his argument was simple.
Vanilla essence is a common ingredient.
They debated the very essence of humanity.
